qa_pairs.question: Which electrical connections all use the same torque specification of 5 Nm?
qa_pairs.answer: Door plug connection to body, fuse box screws for safety fuse, and ground or positive connections

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers plug connections specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 61-1 General Electrical system, subsection 61 13 Plug Connections

qa_pairs.question: Do all the plug connections listed apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all connections are specified for 'All' vehicle types
